Face

Injectable treatments

For a fresh, rested face that still looks like you — without surgery.

    Botox

    Hyaluronic acid

    Skin boosters

    Deep hydration for glow, elasticity and better skin quality.

    Absorbable threads for a gentle lift and collagen stimulation.

The approach

Not a different face or body — yours, in balance.

Every treatment starts with a careful assessment and a plan made for you: what you would like to change, what is realistic, and what is safe. The goal is a result that suits you, so that others notice you look well, not that something was done.

The doctor

Periklis Georgantas

Plastic, reconstructive & aesthetic surgeon

Periklis Georgantas lived, studied and began his medical career in Rome, Italy, where he graduated with distinction from the Medical School of “La Sapienza” University.

Returning to Greece, after completing his military service as an emergency physician, he worked for two years in a remote rural post and then began his specialty at the Naval Hospital of Athens, in the General Surgery department, for 3 years. He completed his specialty over 4 years in the plastic surgery departments of the “Agios Savvas” and KAT hospitals, with corresponding training in general and bariatric surgery, breast and skin-tumour reconstruction, trauma and burns. Further training in aesthetic medicine followed, in Greece and abroad.

Keeping up to date with new materials and methods, both surgical and non-invasive, he takes part in congresses in Greece and abroad, and has taken part in medical missions in the Vihiga and Kisumu counties of Kenya.

Since 2019 he has run his own private practice and works with private hospitals and clinics, and he also organises and presents seminars on non-invasive aesthetic medicine.

Where is the practice?

At 4 Dionysiou Aiginitou St, Athens, opposite the Megaron Athens Concert Hall. The “Megaro Moussikis” metro station (line 3) is a few steps away.

How do I book an appointment?

By phone on +30 697 337 3050 or by e-mail at drgeorgantasplastikos@gmail.com. The practice sees patients by appointment.

What is the difference between non-invasive and surgical treatments?

Non-invasive treatments involve no incision — injectables, peels or laser — and you usually return to your day straight away. Surgical treatments are operations performed in a clinic.

Where are operations performed?

In partner private hospitals and clinics. Assessment and follow-up take place at the practice.

Do I need a consultation before a treatment?

Yes. Every treatment starts with a consultation, where we listen to what you want, examine the area and discuss what is realistic and safe for you.

Does the doctor also perform reconstructive surgery?

Yes. Dr Georgantas trained in breast and skin-tumour reconstruction, trauma and burns, and performs reconstruction of the face and body.

Does the doctor run seminars?

Yes, he organises and presents seminars on non-invasive aesthetic medicine.
